analysis.title: RESIDENTIAL LEASE AGREEMENT
analysis.purpose: To lease a residential property for private dwelling purposes and set forth the terms of rent, security deposit, maintenance responsibilities, and termination conditions.
analysis.shortSummary: This Residential Lease Agreement is entered into by Metro Properties LLC (Landlord) and Sarah Jenkins (Tenant) on July 15, 2026, for the property located at 742 Evergreen Terrace, Unit 4B, Springfield. The contract establishes monthly rent, security deposit terms, and operational responsibilities for both parties under the laws of the State of Illinois.
analysis.detailedSummary:
The Residential Lease Agreement executed on July 15, 2026, establishes a formal tenancy between Metro Properties LLC as the Landlord and Sarah Jenkins as the Tenant for the real property situated at 742 Evergreen Terrace, Unit 4B, Springfield. The premises are restricted strictly to use as a private residential dwelling, and the Tenant is prohibited from assigning the lease or subletting the property.

Financial obligations include the payment of monthly rent in advance on or before the first day of each calendar month, alongside a security deposit required upon the execution of the agreement. Regarding maintenance, the Landlord is tasked with keeping electrical, plumbing, heating, and structural fixtures in good operating condition, while the Tenant holds complementary maintenance duties.

In the event of non-payment of rent or a material covenant violation that remains uncured for fourteen days after notice, specific termination and default remedies apply. Finally, the contract is governed by, construed, and enforced in accordance with the laws of the State of Illinois.
